### Savers Value Village to Host Innovation Day on November 10


October 26, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s202.q4cdn.com/614174375/files/doc_news/Savers-Value-Village-to-Host-Innovation-Day-on-November-10-2026.pdf)


***Featuring Facility and Store Tours***


BELLEVUE, Wash.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Savers Value Village, Inc. (NYSE: SVV) (the “Company”) today announced that it will host an Innovation Day on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. CT in the Minneapolis–St. Paul area.


The event will feature a tour of Savers’ Minneapolis Centralized Processing Center (CPC) and a retail store tour. The attendees will get a firsthand look at the Company’s innovation agenda spanning technology and operations, including demonstrations of ThriftIQ. The event will also include a management presentation and question-and-answer session featuring Mark Walsh, Chief Executive Officer; Jubran Tanious, President and Chief Operating Officer; and Michael Maher, Chief Financial Officer.


In-person attendance is limited to institutional investors and sell-side analysts. Those interested in attending may request an invitation by contacting ADDO Investor Relations atSVV@addo.com . Presentation materials will be made available in the investor relations section of the Company’s website at[ir.savers.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fir.savers.com%2Foverview%2Fdefault.aspx&esheet=54628023&newsitemid=20261026551977&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.savers.com&index=1&md5=21b8fa9fe9e9f23dc556642318de5081) prior to the event.


**About the Savers® Value Village® family of thrift stores**


As the largest for-profit thrift operator in the United States and Canada for value priced pre-owned clothing, accessories and household goods, our mission is to champion reuse and inspire a future where secondhand is second nature. Learn more about the Savers Value Village family of thrift stores, our impact, and the #ThriftProud movement at savers.com.
